content:
olivia: follow-up on rollout metadata: we keep seeing confusion around tenant overrides vs org/global pins. need a deterministic merge rule and a tiny schema tweak to help operators.
tom: +1. current rule "min(leases)" is surprising. tenants think their explicit tenant pin should win.
ria: can we adopt a clear precedence order: T1 = tenant > workspace > org > global? simple and explicit.
sam: that works if we also allow an opt-in "override_by_age" so older pins don't stomp newer canaries. otherwise you get stale pins lingering.
olivia: good point. proposal: add two fields to rollout metadata: "lease_resolution" enum {SCOPE_PRIORITY, AGE_PRIORITY, AFFINITY_SCORE} and "entropy_score" float 0-1. default=SCOPE_PRIORITY.
tom: entropy as a float instead of LOW/HIGH is nicer. we can use it server-side to nudge TTLs: effective = base_lease * (1 - entropy_score*beta) where beta is tunable.
ria: servers should compute resolved_ttl and persist it on the aggregated pin entry. clients always read resolved_ttl. avoids duplication of logic.
sam: agree. also add "pin_origin_ts" so we can pick newer entries for AGE_PRIORITY.
infra-bot: note: schema changes require control-plane flagging and a migration window. schedule maintenance window if doing eager migration.
olivia: migration plan sketch: 1) schema add (backwards compatible), 2) server-side resolution routine runs as a background job scoring multi-scope pins and writing resolved_ttl + resolution_reason, 3) run dry-mode to emit diffs, 4) flip to write-mode and mark migration complete.
tom: what about clients that write pins? they should accept the new optional fields but not require them. SDKs need to expose helper builders.
ria: add telemetry: pin_resolution_reason (SCOPE_PRIORITY / AGE_PRIORITY / AFFINITY_SCORE), and pin_conflicts_count. also a histogram of resolved_ttl.
sam: edgecase: if two tenant pins conflict within same scope but different entropy, how do we choose? rule: within same scope prefer higher affinity_score; tie-breaker newer pin.
olivia: ok let's capture these rules in the RFC follow-up and land schema PR with examples. I'll add compact examples: ```json
{
  "model_id": "meta-v2",
  "pin": {
    "lease_hours": 72,
    "entropy_score": 0.45,
    "lease_resolution": "SCOPE_PRIORITY",
    "pin_origin_ts": 1739999000,
    "resolved_ttl": 1740005600
  }
}
```
tom: add docs for SDK fallback: if resolved_ttl missing, client should compute local heuristic using lease_hours*(1-entropy).
ria: raise migration checklist: dry-run, db backfill throughput, obs dashboards for resolved_ttl deltas, feature-flag for rollout.
olivia: thanks all, aim for RFC update + PR by mid-week. tagging @tom @ria @sam to own parts. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: reminder: any schema bump needs compatibility note in /deploy-notes.
